More details about the retired and new tables are in the Developing a More Integrated NASA Exoplanet Archive page.

The Confirmed Planets table lists all the parameters available from the default literature reference for each planet. These correspond to the highlighted parameters in the respective Confirmed Planet or Planet Host Overview pages, as well as what is displayed in the Confirmed Planets interactive table. For a more filled-in table of confirmed planet parameters drawn from multiple references and/or calculations, see the Composite Planet Data table. For a definition of default parameters, see the Exoplanet Criteria page.

This page lists and defines all of the data columns in the Confirmed Planets (exoplanets) table that can be returned through the Exoplanet Archive's application programming interface (API), or when using the Confirmed Planets interactive table. These column names can also be specified in pre-filtered table queries.

 There are similar documents for other data sets and tables. The full list is in the API User Guide in the Data Available Through the API section (click on the documentation links).

Some data include more specific information that can also be retrieved as separate calls in the API. These include:

This table has been retired and is no longer being updated. Please use the Planetary Systems (PS) or Planetary System Composite Parameters (PSCompPars) Tables for the most current data, and refer to the documentation for data column definitions.. More details about the retired and new tables are in the Developing a More Integrated NASA Exoplanet Archive page.

The Confirmed Planets table lists all the parameters available from the default literature reference for each planet. These correspond to the highlighted parameters in the respective Confirmed Planet or Planet Host Overview pages, as well as what is displayed in the Confirmed Planets interactive table. For a more filled-in table of confirmed planet parameters drawn from multiple references and/or calculations, see the Composite Planet Data table. For a definition of default parameters, see the Exoplanet Criteria page.

This page lists and defines all of the data columns in the Confirmed Planets (exoplanets) table that can be returned through the Exoplanet Archive's application programming interface (API), or when using the Confirmed Planets interactive table. These column names can also be specified in pre-filtered table queries.

 There are similar documents for other data sets and tables. The full list is in the API User Guide in the Data Available Through the API section (click on the documentation links).

Some data include more specific information that can also be retrieved as separate calls in the API. These include:

 Uncertainties (positive and negative)
 Limits
 Number of Measurements

The stellar parameters listed for circumbinary planets (e.g., Kepler-16) are for the primary star. We note that objects are matched to Gaia using the Hipparcos or 2MASS IDs provided in Gaia DR2. Furthermore, the Bailer-Jones (2015) and the Bailer-Jones et al. (2018) distance corrections have not been implemented here, such that the quoted value for "Gaia Distance" is the inverse of the reported Gaia parallax value.
